name: wasm-spatial-core
description: A high-performance WebAssembly spatial data processing engine for frontend Web3D/GIS applications
author: Qingxi <qingxi@zhiqiweilai.com>

scripts.build:wasm:node: cd .. && wasm-pack build --target nodejs --release --out-dir npm/pkg-node -- --features point-cloud,geotiff,laz-support,mesh-ingest && echo '{"type":"commonjs"}' > npm/pkg-node/package.json
scripts.build:wasm:mt: cd .. && RUSTFLAGS='-C target-feature=+atomics,+bulk-memory,+mutable-globals' cargo +nightly build -Z build-std=panic_abort,std --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --release --features multi-thread,point-cloud,geotiff && wasm-bindgen --target web --out-dir npm/pkg target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/wasm_spatial_core.wasm
scripts.build:wasm:pc: cd .. && wasm-pack build --target web --release --out-dir npm/pkg -- --features point-cloud
scripts.build:wasm:laz: cd .. && wasm-pack build --target web --release --out-dir npm/pkg -- --features laz-support,geotiff
scripts.build:wasm:terrain-edit: cd .. && wasm-pack build --target web --release --out-dir npm/pkg -- --features point-cloud,terrain-edit
scripts.build:entries: tsc index.ts node.ts batch.ts draco.ts webgpu.ts abort.ts --target ES2020 --module esnext --moduleResolution bundler --lib ES2020,DOM --types node,@webgpu/types --declaration --strict --esModuleInterop --skipLibCheck --outDir .
scripts.build: npm run build:wasm && npm run build:wasm:node && npm run build:entries
